Could that be the secret to her speed?
I'd certainly love to see it!

Tome-san, Shige-san, Chiyo-san, and Yoshi-san...
They all prayed for my success and sent me off to the Central League.

An Academy Trainer...
Then do you know the way?

We're back here again...!?
What is going on!?

And so, I followed after Oguri Cap
along with the other Trainers, but...

It is strange. For some time now, no matter how much I walk,
I keep arriving back at this very same spot.

Thank you for the training run, Oguri Cap.
...Heh, hahaha!

...I was worried, so I guided Oguri Cap
all the way to the front of the dormitory.

Back home, directions were simple. Turn right at Tome-san's field
and the school is in sight. Turn left at Shige-san's big storehouse for the bus stop.

As she spoke,
Oguri Cap's eyes were resolute.
W-Wait, could she just be a bit eccentric...?

Are there four identical-looking places
at this academy...?

There are times when I miss home.
...However, I cannot return just yet.
Let us do this again sometime, Oguri Cap.

I was well aware of your numerous valiant feats in the Regional League,
but... running alongside you firsthand has truly driven it home.

Oh, where is she going...? Could she be heading off
to do some secret training elsewhere...!?

No, knowing Oguri Cap, there must be
some deeper meaning behind this...!

Still, she somehow seemed troubled,
and I couldn't help but feel concerned—

Oguri Cap, an Umamusume who transferred to Tracen Academy
after racking up an illustrious record in the Regional League.

And challenging her to a race so directly, too...!
She must have nerves of absolute steel...

Baffled by Oguri Cap's enigmatic wandering,
the Trainers began leaving one after another.

I-I give up. Circling the exact same spot four times...
I haven't the faintest clue what goes on inside that girl's head...
Lost... Hmm, that could be it.

Spotted on the training track today,
she had already caught the attention of several quick-eared Trainers...

...Oh, rookie Trainer, are you interested in Oguri as well?
Well then, why don't you come follow her with us!

Oguri Cap—you truly possess formidable strength.
I already look forward to clashing with you out on the turf.

Ah, no, my apologies if I offended you. It was simply such a fruitful
experience that I couldn't help breaking into a smile.

Seeing that Oguri Cap had seemingly gotten lost,
I showed her the way back to the dorms.

...Is that so?
Now that you mention it, the scenery is identical.

Far away in my hometown,
there are people cheering for my victory.

She really is as strong as they say, right...?
Well, maybe we'll come check on her another day...
I see. Next time, let us race.

...By the way, who are you?
Come to think of it, I haven't seen your face before.

I see. Thank you.
...Excuse me, then.
...Now then.

Telling the city scenery apart is difficult. The buildings are close together
and look similar... It is completely different from when I was back home.
Nnnh...

Mmm... It is about time I headed back.
The dorm was this way, correct? All right, this time—
...S-She really isn't starting her training, is she?
...? Why are you laughing?

I want to return to the dormitory.
Could you please give me directions?

Tome-san often gave me mandarins as a snack.
...They were delicious. I miss them.
And I want to live up to those expectations—no matter what.

Incredible, so that's Oguri Cap...!
To run alongside the "Emperor" Symboli Rudolf and not even break a sweat...

Ah, it is almost time for the regular meeting.
I shall take my leave now.

A few minutes after watching Oguri Cap
walk away—

Wha...?! That Trainer has the exact same face as before...?
Could it be... a doppelgänger...!?
Hmm...
Hmm...?
...Whew.
